daytime.source: User-supplied pyModeS network JSONL export from airsquitter.lr.tudelft.nl:10004 over TU Delft VPN
daytime.observation_domain: Single receiver connected to an ADS-B antenna on the roof of the Faculty of Aerospace Engineering, TU Delft, Delft, Netherlands (user report)
daytime.notes: Prepare counts and cumulative DF plots only. Do not sign or replay as the main experiment while experiment_blockers are present. The original JSONL remains unchanged.
daytime.acquisition_command: uvx --with pyModeS modes live --network airsquitter.lr.tudelft.nl:10004 --dump-to daytime.jsonl
daytime.inferred_decoder_version: pyModeS 3.6.0; inferred from matching cached environments, original command was unpinned
daytime.timestamp_date_note: File Unix timestamps indicate Thursday 2026-10-08, 09:30:02.994089–10:40:19.672826 Europe/Amsterdam. The stated October 10 date differs.
daytime.boundary_basis: For traffic-only preparation, anchor the first hour to the earliest supplied timestamp; use the next representable timestamp after the final observation as the exclusive file bound. These file bounds are not verified receiver start/stop times or proof of RF coverage.
daytime.timestamp_semantics: Receiver-counter differences within TCP bursts, re-anchored to host wall clock for every burst; original counters omitted from JSONL.
experiment_blockers: The decoder re-anchors every TCP burst to host wall-clock time. Cross-burst timestamps include network/processing jitter, so the radio-overlap model would measure timestamp artifacts as collisions.
The JSONL omits original receiver counters; sorting cannot reconstruct the lost cross-burst timing. A lossless receiver recording or a new capture is needed.
The decoder skips Mode A/C replies. This file represents recorded decoded Mode S frames, not confirmed complete 1090 MHz traffic.

nighttime.notes: Complete this entry from acquisition metadata; timestamps must use explicit seconds. Planned recording: 60-minute target window plus 10-minute authentication follow-up.
